question: Without inserting a spin structure: do fermionic grading and the oriented marks force the nontrivial projective lift A4 -> 2T (central element = (-1)^F) instead of the trivial linear action?
verdict_scope: Source channels: flavor fiber, windings, three family CAR modes, twist zero modes (N = 16, species-singlet), seam rotation (NS/R). Statement about the microscopic mark-rotation class; the IR statement holds for a two-component coin at an isotropic Weyl node.
mathematical_verdict: FOCK_IMPLEMENTATION_OF_GENUINE_ACTION_HAS_SCALAR_CENTER_CLASS_W2_EQUALS_M3_MOD_2; NUMBER_CONSERVING_ACTIONS_TRIVIAL; SPIN_STATISTICS_REQUIRES_PROJECTIVE_ONE_PARTICLE_ACTION; SQUARE_MARKED_SEAM_SYMMETRY_D4_ROTATIONS_Z4_A4_PART_Z2_NO_C3; SEAM_ROTATION_LIFT_CONDITIONAL_NS; SPIN_HALF_EMERGENT_GIVEN_TWO_COMPONENT_COIN (2pi action coincides with the existing fermion parity; not an IR derivation of spin-statistics; not usable to derive the coin)
summary_de: Die Quelle erzwingt den 2T-Lift nicht: Fock-Implementierungen genuiner Einteilchenwirkungen haben skalare Zentrumselemente (Klasse w2 = m3 mod 2), teilchenzahlerhaltende Wirkungen sind trivial, Spin-Statistik braucht eine projektive Einteilchenwirkung. Die quadratisch markierte Naht hat nur D4 (Rotationen Z4), mit A4 gemeinsam nur <(02)(13)>, keine C3. Der NS-Lift der Nahtdrehung ist bedingt (Spinorschnitt-Praemisse). Spin 1/2 emergiert am isotropen Weyl-Knoten, sobald ein zweikomponentiger Coin existiert; seine 2pi-Wirkung stimmt mit der bereits vorhandenen Fermionparitaet ueberein (keine IR-Herleitung der Spin-Statistik, keine Herleitung des Coins). Verbleibender Input: der Coin selbst (AX.WEYLCOIN).
kills: Fock/Clifford implementation of a genuine one-particle mark action producing spin-statistics (center is scalar, never (-1)^F).
Nontrivial A4 class from number-conserving family modes (m_3 even).
2T class from the twist zero modes with N = 16 species-singlet operators.
C3 / A4 as a geometric symmetry of the square-marked chiral seam (Moebius stabiliser D4, orientation-preserving Z4).
resolved: Class formula w2 = m_3 mod 2 for genuine real one-particle A4 actions; spin-statistics <=> projective one-particle action.

Spin 1/2 emerges at an isotropic Weyl node once a two-component coin exists; its 2pi action coincides with the fermion parity already present (no IR derivation of spin-statistics; the coin itself is presupposed).
